# ORION 1.0 — 24-Hour National Level Hackathon

> ORION 1.0 is a 24-hour national level offline hackathon organized by Microsoft Club SIST at Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology (SIST), Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. It has a ₹1,00,000 prize pool and is open to college students (UG, PG, PhD) and early-career professionals across India.

## Key facts

- Organizer: Microsoft Club SIST, Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology, Chennai
- Format: Round 1 online PPT idea submission, then a 24-hour offline Grand Finale for the Top 70 teams
- Registration and Round 1 deadline: 21 September 2026
- Grand Finale: 9–10 October 2026 (tentative), Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology, Jeppiaar Nagar, Rajiv Gandhi Salai (OMR), Chennai 600119
- Team size: 2–6 members (solo participation not allowed; cross-college teams allowed)
- Fees: ₹100 flat per team for Round 1; ₹250 per head for Grand Finale finalists; non-refundable
- Prize pool: ₹1,00,000 — ₹25,000 champion, ₹15,000 1st runner-up, ₹10,000 2nd runner-up, plus special track bounties
- Round 1 tracks: FloatChat (Oceanic AI / ARGO ocean data), LexVault (zero-knowledge blockchain), SylvaSense (satellite remote sensing for climate), Open Innovation
- Registration: https://forms.gle/txiRwn9EELUgZvrJ6
- Contact: msclubsist@gmail.com · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/orion1.0_
